reading.zh: 从左到右：config 读配置，stereo 取双目观测，voxel 维护体素，mapper 累积栅格化建图，frontier 选探索边界，nav-session 管建图会话；箭头是观测自双目流向地图与边界。
reading.en: Left to right: config reads settings, stereo takes the stereo observations, voxel maintains the volume, mapper accumulates and rasterises the map, frontier picks exploration edges and nav-session owns the mapping session; arrows run from the stereo view into the map and frontier.
